overview.zh: 以周秦汉唐历史、考古博物馆、城墙和大型遗址公园为核心的古都，城东临潼与主城区需要分日规划。
overview.en: An ancient capital centered on Zhou-Qin-Han-Tang history, archaeology museums, the city wall, and major heritage parks; eastern Lintong and central Xi'an should be planned on separate days.

provider.zh: 中国气象局公共气象服务
provider.en: China Meteorological Administration public weather service

note.zh: 查看西安实时预报后，再到中央气象台核验高温、强对流和大风等预警。
note.en: Check Xi'an's live forecast, then review heat, severe-weather, and wind alerts from the National Meteorological Center.

name.en: Xi'an Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism

operator.en: Xi'an Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism

use_for.zh: 查看西安文旅新闻、行业公告、公共服务和旅游投诉信息。
use_for.en: Use for Xi'an tourism news, sector notices, public services, and tourism-complaint information.

international_gateways.zh: 西安北站高速铁路枢纽

local.zh: 临潼景区交通（需实时核验）
local.en: Lintong attraction transport requiring live checks

notes.zh: 兵马俑和华清宫位于临潼，市中心往返应按一日行程计算，并核验正规交通。
notes.en: The Terracotta Army and Huaqing Palace are in Lintong; treat central-city transfers as a day trip and verify legitimate transport.

notes.zh: 博物馆、城墙和演出预约与开放时间不保存在静态数据中。
notes.en: Museum, city-wall, and performance reservations and hours are not stored in static data.

name.en: Bell and Drum Towers inside the City Wall

tradeoff.zh: 老城步行和地铁方便，夜间热闹；热门街区可能嘈杂拥挤。
tradeoff.en: Convenient for old-city walking and metro access; lively but potentially noisy and crowded.

name.en: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda and Qujiang

tradeoff.zh: 夜游、演艺和亲子设施集中；前往城墙西北侧需换乘。
tradeoff.en: Concentrated in evening attractions, performances, and family facilities; requires transfers to the northwest old city.

tradeoff.zh: 适合兵马俑和华清宫的早出晚归或一晚停留；不便覆盖主城区。
tradeoff.en: Useful for early access or an overnight around the Terracotta Army and Huaqing Palace; inconvenient for central-city coverage.

clothing.zh: 分层穿着并准备防风外套。
分层穿着，深秋增加保暖外套。
clothing.en: Layers, adding warmer outerwear in late autumn.

clothing.zh: 保暖外套、帽子、手套和防风鞋。
clothing.en: Warm coat, hat, gloves, and wind-resistant footwear.

culture.en: Qinqiang opera and Shaanxi folk arts

dietary_notes.zh: 通常含小麦和猪肉或牛羊肉；清真与非清真店铺需分清。
dietary_notes.en: Usually contains wheat and pork or beef/lamb; distinguish halal and non-halal venues.

dietary_notes.zh: 含小麦，汤底和肉类来源需按饮食要求确认。
dietary_notes.en: Contains wheat; confirm broth and meat sourcing for dietary needs.

dietary_notes.zh: 常含小麦或米制品、辣椒油、芝麻或花生，配方因店而异。
dietary_notes.en: May use wheat or rice, chili oil, sesame, or peanuts; recipes vary.

ticket.note: Verify the official ticket product and included museum zones.

booking.note: Confirm real-name passport booking, release windows, and entry gate.

summary.zh: 以兵马俑坑和秦陵考古展示为核心的世界遗产博物院；需把临潼往返交通计入日程。
summary.en: A World Heritage museum centered on the Terracotta Army pits and Qin mausoleum archaeology; include Lintong transfers in the day plan.

note.zh: 请核验预约、开放区域和官方接驳安排。
note.en: Verify reservations, open zones, and official transfers.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应西安市官方名录中的秦始皇帝陵博物院。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum Site Museum in Xi'an's official list.

ticket.note: Day admission, performances, ropeway, and other products may be separate.

booking.note: Confirm day entry separately from any evening performance.

summary.zh: 结合唐代宫苑历史、温泉遗址和近现代历史的临潼景区，可与兵马俑同日但需控制时长。
summary.en: A Lintong scenic area combining Tang palace history, hot-spring remains, and modern history; it can pair with the Terracotta Army if time is controlled.

note.zh: 日游、演出和山体项目分别核验。
note.en: Verify daytime access, performances, and mountain activities separately.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应西安市官方名录中的华清宫景区整体。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to Huaqing Palace Scenic Area as a whole in Xi'an's official list.

name.zh: 大雁塔·大唐芙蓉园景区
name.en: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda–Tang Paradise Scenic Area

neighborhood_name.en: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda and Qujiang

ticket.note: Pagoda, temple, Tang Paradise, performances, and public squares have separate rules.

booking.note: Build the plan from specific components and verify each operator.

summary.zh: 官方评级覆盖大雁塔文化片区与大唐芙蓉园的组合景区；公共广场、寺院、登塔、园区和演出不是同一张票。
summary.en: The official rating covers a combined scenic area around the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda and Tang Paradise; public squares, temple, pagoda ascent, park, and shows do not share one ticket.

note.zh: 各组成部分开放与预约规则不同。
note.en: Component venues have different opening and booking rules.

scope_note.zh: 5A 等级对应“大雁塔·大唐芙蓉园景区”这一组合名称，不应自动赋给每个内部单点。
scope_note.en: The 5A rating applies to the combined Giant Wild Goose Pagoda–Tang Paradise Scenic Area and should not automatically be assigned to every component venue.

name.zh: 西安城墙·碑林历史文化景区
name.en: Xi'an City Wall–Beilin Historic Cultural Scenic Area

neighborhood_name.en: Inside the City Wall and Beilin

ticket.note: City Wall and Beilin Museum are distinct admissions and locations.

booking.note: Verify each component's gate, closure day, and entry requirements.

summary.zh: 官方评级将西安城墙与碑林历史文化资源组合呈现；实际游览应分别核对入口和票务，可按南门—碑林片区衔接。
summary.en: The official rating combines the City Wall and Beilin heritage resources; in practice, check separate entrances and tickets and connect them around the South Gate–Beilin area.

note.zh: 城墙活动和博物馆闭馆安排需分别核验。
note.en: Verify city-wall events and museum closures separately.

scope_note.zh: 5A 等级对应“西安城墙·碑林历史文化景区”组合范围，不表示两个组成单位各自单独为 5A。
scope_note.en: The 5A rating applies to the combined City Wall–Beilin historic scenic area, not necessarily to each component as a standalone 5A site.

ticket.note: Open park space, archaeological zones, and exhibitions may have different admission rules.

booking.note: Confirm open gates, exhibitions, and internal transport.

summary.zh: 展示唐代宫城格局与考古遗址的大尺度遗址公园，尺度空旷，适合重视历史空间而非完整古建筑的游客。
summary.en: A large archaeological park revealing the Tang palace plan and remains, best for visitors interested in historic space rather than intact ancient buildings.

note.zh: 展馆、遗址区和接驳运营需分别核验。
note.en: Verify galleries, archaeological zones, and internal transport separately.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应西安市官方名录中的大明宫国家遗址公园。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to Daming Palace National Heritage Park in Xi'an's official list.

ticket.note: General admission and special exhibitions may follow different rules.

booking.note: High-demand real-name reservations and passport rules must be checked officially.

summary.zh: 系统展示陕西古代文明的重要博物馆，预约需求通常高；不要把未确认的抢票攻略当作规则。
summary.en: A major museum presenting ancient Shaanxi civilization with typically high booking demand; do not treat unverified booking tips as official rules.

warnings: Closed days and hours may change

note.zh: 预约放票、闭馆日和展览状态需实时核验。
note.en: Reservation release, closure days, and exhibition status require live verification.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应西安市官方名录中的陕西历史博物馆。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to Shaanxi History Museum in Xi'an's official list.
